$description: Tool Button V2 Component Contract. It is an independent action-control contract and does not inherit Button Intent or Appearance axes.

presentation.meaning: standard or auto-raise visual interaction policy

menu.split: primary action and secondary menu trigger
menu.open: runtime popup lifecycle; not a visual State

presentation.meaning: surface policy; auto-raise is not an interaction State

value.meaning: persistent checked value independent of hover, pressed and disabled

pointerInteraction.meaning: default, hover and pressed express interaction visuals

availability.meaning: disabled locks the action while preserving value

menuLifecycle.meaning: open/close, menu population and trigger events

compositionRules: Tool Button is an independent component family; Button Intent and Appearance are not inherited.
Presentation, Value, State and Menu are separate dimensions and are not encoded as compound State names.
checked-hover resolves as value=checked plus state=hover.
hover-pressed resolves as state=pressed with the active hover overlay; it is not a separate State.
auto-raise is presentation=auto-raise and may not be combined with menu=split.
open belongs to the runtime menu lifecycle and does not create a visual Token axis.
Split menu structure is represented by the menu Slot and runtime API; the divider and action width are sparse component visuals.
Label and icon are optional content properties, not additional visual axes.
